title: Unique words, sorted
summary: Every different word of a file, once, in alphabetical order, for a file of any size.
hints: Read words with `fscanf(f, "%63s", w)` into a `char **` that grows with `realloc` (copy each with `strdup`), sort with `qsort` and `strcmp`.
After sorting, a word is a repeat if it equals the previous one: print only when it differs.
